# llm/output-to-sink

Model output used as code, SQL, a command, or HTML.

Output of a language model call (generateText().text, result.object, choices[0].message.content, content[0].text, streamed text, useChat messages) reaching eval, new Function, child_process, raw SQL, or an HTML sink without a sanitizer or schema check.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: block; warn in example or template folders. A schema parse or a sanitizer on the value clears it.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-94](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/94.html), [CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html), [CWE-89](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html), [CWE-79](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/79.html), OWASP LLM05:2025.

## Why it matters

Models follow instructions hidden in the text they read (prompt injection), so executing their output or rendering it as HTML gives whoever wrote that text control of the server or the page. OWASP LLM05 (improper output handling).

## Flagged

`app/api/report/route.ts`:

```ts
const rows = await pool.query(text);
```

`app/api/report/route.ts`:

```ts
const noted = await pool.query(`INSERT INTO notes (body) VALUES ('${object.note}')`);
```

`components/Chat.tsx`:

```tsx
<div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: marked.parse(m.content) }} />
```

`server/agent.ts`:

```ts
const result = eval(code);
```

`server/agent.ts`:

```ts
execSync(command);
```

`server/agent.ts`:

```ts
execSync(`grep -r ${args.pattern} src`);
```

`src/stream.ts`:

```ts
output.innerHTML = html;
```

## Not flagged

- `const sorted = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM invoices ORDER BY ${object.sortBy}');` in `app/api/report/route.ts`: enum field of a schema-checked object
- `const safe = await pool.query('INSERT INTO notes (body) VALUES ($1)', [text]);` in `app/api/report/route.ts`: model output passed as a parameter
- `<div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(m.content) as string) }} />` in `components/Chat.tsx`: sanitized
- `<p>{m.content}</p>` in `components/Chat.tsx`: JSX text is escaped
- `<div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: input }} />` in `components/Chat.tsx`: the draft the user is typing is not model output (web/xss-html-sink warns)
- `if (ALLOWED_COMMANDS.includes(command)) execSync(command);` in `server/agent.ts`: checked against an allowlist first
- `return eval(expression);` in `server/agent.ts`: not model output (reported by web/code-eval as warn)
- `const rows = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM faq WHERE topic = '${req.body.topic}' AND answer = '${text}'');` in `server/mixed.js`: request data at the same sink is reported by web/sql-injection
- `output.textContent = await result.text;` in `src/stream.ts`: textContent is not parsed as HTML

## How to fix

Treat model output as untrusted input: map it to fixed values with a schema or an allowlist, sanitize HTML with DOMPurify, and never pass it to eval, a shell, or raw SQL.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore llm/output-to-sink: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "llm/output-to-sink": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
